autumn_colors.jpg: Autumn colors near the top of Bugaksan, Seoul, South Korea
cheongundae_goofy_top.jpg: Top of Cheongundae. Only the top of the mountain is exposed, leaving just the tip visible. It's kind of funny.
jensen_huang_cafe.jpg: This cafe has been approved by Jensen Huang. It is located in Hongdae main street (exact address : 서울 마포구 어울마당로 115-1).
stranger_cap.jpg: A cap in a shop, the korean text reads the word stranger.
deep_thinking_buddha.jpeg: A deep thinking bodhisattva statue. The statue is located in Nation Museum of Korea 2F in the quiet contemplation room.
7022_bus_near_anguk_station.jpg: The four digit buses are green. 7 stands for the area of operation, indeed, 7 is for Eunpyeong-gu, Seodaemun-gu, and Mapo-gu. Perfect if you need to go from Anguk to Eungam.
barbecue_hongik_1.jpg: A barbecue restaurant in Hongik University area. You can make maekju by mixing korean beer and soju.
cheese_cat.jpg: In Korea a cheese cat (치즈 고양이 / 치즈냥) is an orange colored cat, this name comes from the fact that the color of cheedar like cheese in Korea is likely orange. This cat is a cheese cat, even though he is not fully orange, you can call him cream cheese cat.
korean_meal_before_hairdresser.jpg: This is the traditionnal korean meal I ate before going to the hairdresser. The restaurant owner is a very nice and joyful grandma. She is very kind and attentionate with her customers. The meal was delicious and the price was very reasonable.
pajeon_experiment.jpg: This is my first try at making pajeon (파전), a korean pancake. I used a recipe from a random website. The result was fairly good. I can say that because the pancake was approved by the grandma from the closest convenience store from my house. I was very happy to have her approval.
tori_paitan_ramen.jpg: Tori paitan ramen (鶏白湯ラーメン) is a japanese ramen with a creamy chicken broth. This ramen is from a ramen shop in a small and cute neighborhood not far from my house. The ramen was excellent and very rich.
big_ass_ginkgo.jpg: I went to Jangsu-dong and there was a very big ginkgo tree. I took a picture of it and struggled to frame it in a way that would show how massive it was. It was really big, trust me. Just imagine a huge tree, it was bigger than that. And very old also.
cat_from_incheon.jpg: A cat I saw in Incheon chinatown taking a nap, I guess, but I don't know because I can't speak cat language. Sorry.
gyeongbokgung_from_above.jpg: Gyeongbokgung viewed from above. You can get this view by going to the top of the National Museum of Korean Comtemporary History and Art. The view is very nice, and the museum is very interesting too (lie, I didn't visit the museum).
jjajangmyeon.jpg: Delicious jjajangmyeon (짜장면) from a restaurant in Incheon chinatown. This is the perfect place to enjoy this meal because jjajangmyeon is a koreanized chinese dish, and Incheon chinatown is the place where this dish was first created in Korea.
trees_inside_cafe.jpg: Why is there trees inside my cafe ?
dol_hareubang_smirk.jpg: This is a dol hareubang (돌하르방) statue, a traditional statue from Jeju island. This one is smirking, it reminds me of roblox man face asset, kind of funny.
goofy_ahh_museum_bird.jpg: A goofy ahh bird seen at a museum in Jeju.
monkey_statue_jogyesa_temple.jpg: A monkey statue exposed in Jogyesa temple, all others statues of chinese zodiac animals are also present in this temple. This monkey statue is the best because this is my sign, no debate allowed.
people_enjoying_seafood_under_rain.jpg: Koreans eating seafood under the rain in Jeju. The seafood is really fresh and the rain was very heavy but they deployed a makeshift tent.
spiciest_dish_ever.jpg: This was probably the spiciest dish I have ever eaten since I arrived in Korea. And if you are wondering was this was, it was a spicy ray salad.
cosmos_field.jpg: Cosmos field located in the Olympic Park in Seoul. The flowers were very beautiful and the weather was absolutely perfect.
crazy_expensive_apples.jpg: Crazy expensive apples in Hongdae Mart. The price was 11000 wons for 3 apples, which is about 7,46 euros.
national_museum_of_korea.jpg: National Museum of Korea. The museum is very interesting and has a great collection of Korean art and history. You can buy miniature hanok (한옥) models in the museum shop, and extremely expensive traditional korean pottery.
casiopea_lp.jpg: A findings (not from Feldup) found by searching in a LP store in Yongsan electronic market. The LP is from Casiopea, a japanese jazz fusion band.
seoul_international_fireworks_festival.j: This is a photo from the Seoul International Fireworks Festival. The festival is held every year in Yeouido, and it is a very popular event. Attendance estimated at more than 1 million people.
too_many_things_market.jpg: A small tunnel of random things in Dongmyo flea market. You can find really random things in this market, like a Mao Zedong portrait frame (as it is mentioned in the wikipedia page).
very_korean_restaurant.jpg: This is a very korean restaurant. Which serves very korean food. The restaurant is very korean, and the food is very korean. I really enjoyed this very korean restaurant.
vista_cafe.jpg: View from Nakta cafe in Seoul with a very nice panorama of the city.
